    SELECT TOP(1) [m].[IdModelo], [m].[description], [m].[creationdate], [m].[name]
    FROM [Modelo] AS [m]
    WHERE [m].[IdModelo] = @__id_0
) AS [t]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [m0].[CategoriasIdCategoria], [m0].[ModelosIdModelo], [c].[id], [c].[description], [c].[estado], [c].[name]
    FROM [ModeloCategoria] AS [m0]
    INNER JOIN [Categoria] AS [c] ON [m0].[CategoriasIdCategoria] = [c].[id]
) AS [t0] ON [t].[IdModelo] = [t0].[ModelosIdModelo]
LEFT JOIN [ModeloImagen] AS [m1] ON [t].[IdModelo] = [m1].[idmodelo]
ORDER BY [t].[IdModelo], [t0].[CategoriasIdCategoria], [t0].[ModelosIdModelo], [t0].[id]
